description: JSON output of grid project repo add|edit|remove <project> --json; internal/cli/project_repo.go:102-111. state is always applied. item is the repository as projects/<project>/repos.json holds it, written for add and edit and absent for remove. The plugin keeps every key of an existing item in order (internal/projects/repos.go:18-21), so item names the four keys add writes and allows others. The app reads state and item and passes item through (app internal/slices/projectsettings/project_repos_write.go:96-106).
title: grid project repo output
